summary: Iteration 40 - ACTOOS PRO Intervention Workflow Testing Complete. All core features verified: 1) Photo upload with tags (avant/pendant/après) - POST /api/photos/interventions/{id} working, 2) Photo listing - GET /api/photos/interventions/{id} working, 3) Photo delete - DELETE /api/photos/{id} working, 4) Notes d'intervention - POST /api/interventions/{id}/notes working, 5) Complete with signature - POST /api/interventions/{id}/complete-with-signature working, 6) PDF report generation - GET /api/interventions/{id}/report/pdf working, 7) Categories listing - GET /api/categories working. Backend: 16/17 tests passed (94%). Frontend: All UI elements verified.
